high_level_description: This image depicts an urban scene featuring a prominent building with architectural elements that suggest it is part of the University of Madras, as indicated by the sign on the gate. The building has a mix of traditional and modern architectural styles, with domes and intricate detailing on the upper sections. A tall, modern communication tower stands prominently in the background, contrasting with the historical architecture. The foreground shows a wide road with a median strip containing some greenery and a few small plants.
